title: GoOrganicAfrica 44-country calculator data readiness matrix
scope: Tracks evidence-to-calculator completion for the 43 research-only countries outside the 11 calculator-enabled profiles. The 44-country evidence register includes Botswana, which is now enabled in mixed-source operational mode but is not fully locally data-ready. This is a work queue, not a certification of data quality.
safeguards: Do not modify the 10 original active country profiles or calculator formulas in this workstream.
Botswana is calculator-enabled in mixed-source mode; do not describe its 17 commodity profiles as fully locally validated.
Do not activate any other country until required commodity-level values have provenance, dates, units, regional scope and validation.
Never fill missing prices, yields or costs with invented values.
Keep national statistics, market prices, farmgate prices and modelled estimates clearly distinguished.

batch_02_review.source_notes: The FAO-hosted DAPSA catalogue exposes a public variable dictionary for the 2024-2025 EAA. PARCELLE_P1_ano contains 15,809 cases and 285 variables, including household/parcel IDs, survey weights, region, agroecological zone, declared parcel area in hectares and principal crop. prodpluv_ano contains 10,580 cases and 147 variables, including region, agroecological zone, crop, harvested quantity, sale quantity, sale unit, and average unit sale price. base_intrant_ano contains 5,191 cases and 15 variables, including input type, region, agroecological zone, quantity, unit, amount paid and unit price paid. maindeouevrembauche_ano contains 1,309 cases and 12 variables, including region, agroecological zone, worker category, number hired, days, hours per day, payment method and amount paid per person.
